name: Meals on Wheels San Mateo County (Peninsula Volunteers)
description: Peninsula Volunteers (PVI) operates Meals on Wheels in San Mateo and Santa Clara counties, delivering over 3,000 healthy meals a week to primarily homebound seniors and disabled people who are unable to cook and shop for themselves.
fullDescription: Peninsula Volunteers (PVI) operates Meals on Wheels in San Mateo and Santa Clara counties, delivering over 3,000 healthy meals a week to primarily homebound seniors and disabled people who are unable to cook and shop for themselves.
whatTheyOffer:
- Weekday meal delivery, plus some holiday and weekend meals for eligible clients
- Subsidized meals for eligible seniors 60+ (based on circumstance, not income)
- Private-pay meal delivery for anyone, with no age or disability requirement
- Safety check with each delivery
- Nutrition counseling from a registered dietitian and in-home assessments
- Referrals to other community resources
howToGetIt: Call 650-323-2022 or fill out the online form to apply. Subsidized meals are for adults 60+ who are homebound, unable to reliably shop or cook due to a health condition, or recovering from a hospital stay. An in-home assessment is required at the start of service. There may be a waiting list depending on where you live.
keywords: Meals on Wheels, San Mateo County, Santa Clara County, Peninsula Volunteers, PVI, home delivered meals, senior meals, homebound, disabled, Menlo Park
